create_pendulum_environment: create a pendulum swingup environment by calling swingup with a custom time_limit and random seed
get_pole_vertical: get the vertical z component of the pole frame using Physics.pole_vertical method
get_angular_velocity: get the angular velocity of the pendulum pole using Physics.angular_velocity method
get_observation: get an observation dict with pole orientation and angular velocity using SwingUp.get_observation
get_reward: get the swingup reward based on pole vertical tolerance using SwingUp.get_reward
